notes.title: Development News and Demo Update
notes.notes:
Greetings!The development of YOKAI GODDESS continues!
The First Act is about 75% complete. The action segments, including levels and bosses, are ready. The main focus now is on cutscenes and adventure sections, about half of which are already complete.

If work keeps progressing at the current pace, the release of the First Act can be expected around December 2025.

08/29 Demo UpdateNew Features:
- Gamepad support
- Customizable controls
- Level rank screen
Fixes:
- Critical bug when trying to parry the boss’s fire projectiles
- Visual bug where the blinking silhouette didn’t match the boss sprite
Balance:
- Reduced boss health
- Reworked dash attack timings
Other:
- Minor text adjustments
